scope: Exact Building F / 143 central block only; search for building-specific current street imagery and approved architectural elevations/sections.
conclusion: No defensible Building F-specific street-level image, approved elevation, or section was found in accessible sources. The facade is therefore left undetailed and neutral. The 2025 overhead imagery supports only the roof outline and a rough five-break roof rhythm; all ridge placement and roof heights remain estimates.

modeling_decision: Keep plain neutral shell. Retain the five-break roof rhythm only as an overhead-derived estimate; explicitly mark roof ridge count, ridge positions, pitch, eave height, and ridge height as uncertain. Do not treat GIS ring as surveyed wall footprint.
